deviations: Check D2 of reference/phase1/Scripts/Reconciliation/pipeline-reconciliation-report.sql was not changed, and that script, active-member-difference.sql and paid-member-difference.sql were not run. The Developer's tools cannot edit files under reference/ or run SQLCMD scripts. I asked the owner (deferred). Assumption, following ASM-009: these become listed handover steps for a human. (1) Add payment_method_id, payer_type_id and concession_type_id to D2's expected star, taken from silv_daily_count_detail, and to its join and grouping with fact_daily_member_count_detail. (2) After one usp_run_daily_load on the synthetic data, run the three scripts and record the RS-1 and D2 verdicts. Until (1) is done, D2 will report differences against the 8-column fact.

usp_run_daily_load passes only its @FullRebuild to usp_load_silv_daily_count. DES-001 says 'the run's @FullRebuild and @RebuildFrom', but usp_run_daily_load has no @RebuildFrom parameter, and the design keeps its parameters unchanged. So @RebuildFrom keeps its default (NULL), and @DailyCountBatchDays and @DetailBatchDays keep their defaults (31), the same values the silver and gold steps passed before.
notes:
Baseline before any change: 2 of the Tester's 20 tests passed and 18 failed. Now all 20 pass, plus my 5 unit tests (test_MOD029_dev).

Changes:
- usp_load_silver gains @SkipDailyCount bit = 0, which skips its call to usp_load_silv_daily_count.
- usp_load_gold gains @SkipDailyFact bit = 0, which skips its call to usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail.
- With no switch, both run exactly as before, including the manual @FullRebuild and @RebuildFrom rebuilds.
- usp_run_daily_load now runs, under one run_id and in this order: bronze; silver with @SkipDailyCount = 1; gold with @SkipDailyFact = 1; usp_run_payment_segments; usp_load_silv_daily_count @FullRebuild; usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail.
- Its parameters, its 'run' row logging and its CATCH (log Failed, THROW) are unchanged, and it opens no transaction of its own. If a segment load fails, the run fails before the daily steps, so they stay as the previous run left them.

The three procedures keep the Phase 1 lower-case keyword style, so the advisory sqlfluff capitalisation findings are left as they are.

Unit tests cover:
- the step order and the single run_id;
- the arguments each step receives (skip switches set, only FullRebuild passed to the daily count);
- the segment-failure path: the run is re-raised, its row is logged Failed with the message, and no daily step runs;
- the silver and gold steps that still run after a skipped step.

The MIG-0031 down script restores the MOD-023 usp_run_daily_load and the Phase 1 usp_load_silver and usp_load_gold. The round-trip passes and no grants are needed.

The handover documentation update (AC-026-21) is the Technical Writer's.

Test-first: the first run had 2 of 20 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 20 of 20 and 5 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
